title: Welcome to the Study
body: This tool lets you explore and compare multiple high-dimensional Pareto frontiers of dietary plans. Each frontier represents a different dietary strategy, and each solution within it is nutritionally optimal. Your goal is to analyse trade-offs within and across strategies. Tutorial (~5 min)  →  Tasks (20–25 min)  →  Questionnaire (1–2 min) A reminder will appear once 5 minutes of the tutorial have passed. During the tasks you will use either the full dashboard with all visualisation features, or a reduced benchmark version with a limited chart set. DISCLAIMER: All data in this study is entirely synthetic and should not be taken as dietary advice.
